name: Tick decisions
description:
Shows: What the scheduler tick decided per day, by agent and reason (dispatch, bugs_first, no_eligible_bug, no_eligible_feature, in_flight, mark_lost...). Reads tick.decision; reason_d drops the per-issue detail.
Why it matters: Explains idle time: when nothing ships, this shows whether there was no work, work was blocked behind a gate, or something was stuck. An agent skipped for the same reason for days is a stalled pipeline.
